_comment: Slither configuration for the LuckyDraw contracts. Run from `contracts/`:
Triage of every finding lives in docs/REVIEW.md, section 'Static analysis (Slither) and Codex cross-check preparation (2026-09-16)'.
detectors_to_exclude is empty on purpose: no detector is silenced. A detector may only be added here together
with a one-line reason appended to this comment and the matching per-finding triage in docs/REVIEW.md;
per-finding triage in REVIEW.md is always preferred over silencing a whole detector.
fail_on is 'none' while the CI job is non-blocking (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job 'slither'); raise it to
'medium' once every Medium finding is triaged as fixed or accepted with an owner and the triage is checked in.
Slither 0.11.6 cannot resolve `import {Name as Alias}` for custom errors and then drops the enclosing
functions from the analysis, so a run is only trustworthy when it logs no 'ERROR:ContractSolcParsing' line.
No src/ file uses such an alias any more (the last two were dropped on 2026-09-18), so a run over this tree
is authoritative. The CI job greps for that line anyway and fails on it; do not remove that guard, and do not
reintroduce an alias — rename the error in src/Errors.sol instead.
